modules.text:
A statue's disruptions are warnings with poor manners: hostile visitors, fire, lightning, sudden travel, or changed ground may follow an unprotected harvest. A [[Place of Power|guide_places_of_power]] is the proper remedy. Its structure protects the work and improves the flow.

The old transcript speaks in solemn names and half-buried warnings. Keep the useful lesson: power has a cost when handled carelessly. Build the pattern, check the statue's range, and let the machine do the dangerous work at a measured pace.
